fact: The party travels deeper into the Underdark through a region thick with Faerzress.
source_quote: The party pressed deeper into the Underdark, passing through a region thick with Faerzress
subject: travel through Faerzress

fact: Faerzress is a strange magical radiation that warps tunnels and makes teleportation all but impossible.
source_quote: the strange magical radiation that warps the tunnels and makes teleportation all but impossible
subject: Faerzress

fact: The party hypothesizes that the Faerzress 'went blink' causing madness and the appearance of demons.
source_quote: Faerzress is also the thing that "went blink and caused everybody to go mad." The party's working hypothesis is that the blink somehow caused the demons to show up
subject: Faerzress origin

fact: The GM ruled out the theory that Plinki caused the Faerzress event by experimenting with the obelisk.
source_quote: Out of character, the GM ruled out the theory that Plinki caused it experimenting with the obelisk
subject: GM ruling on obelisk theory

fact: There are fist-sized chunks of quartz scattered in the area that shed a dim light in a 10-foot radius.
source_quote: Scattered through the area were fist-sized chunks of quartz that shed a dim light in a 10-foot radius
subject: glowing quartz chunks

fact: When hurled against a hard surface, the quartz chunks burst into a blinding flash in a 10-foot radius.
source_quote: Sarith explained that these crystals, when hurled against a hard surface, burst into a blinding flash in a 10-foot radius
subject: glowing quartz chunks

fact: Creatures caught in the quartz flash must make a DC 10 Constitution save or be blinded for a minute.
source_quote: Any creature caught in the flash must make a DC 10 Constitution save or be blinded for a minute
subject: glowing quartz chunks

fact: The blindness effect from the quartz chunks can be repeated by the blinded creature at the end of each of its turns.
source_quote: repeating the save at the end of each of its turns
subject: glowing quartz chunks

fact: Gyrgum advises throwing the quartz crystals at least 10 feet away.
source_quote: Gyrgum concluded that you should throw it at least 10 feet
subject: Gyrgum's advice

fact: Daz rolls a 19 on Arcana.
source_quote: Daz rolled a 19 on Arcana
subject: Daz's Arcana check

fact: Daz recalls Zalthir's earlier explanation that magical darkness blocks all light, including magical light.
source_quote: recalled Zalthir's earlier explanation: magical darkness blocks all light, even magical light
subject: Daz recalls Zalthir's explanation

fact: The party harvests twelve of the glowing stones.
source_quote: pocketing twelve of the glowing stones
subject: harvesting crystals

fact: Fuurm is a wretched human former slave of the Drow.
source_quote: The party discovers two wretched humans, Fuurm and Baedora, who are former slaves of the Drow
subject: Fuurm

fact: Baedora is a wretched human former slave of the Drow.
source_quote: The party discovers two wretched humans, Fuurm and Baedora, who are former slaves of the Drow
subject: Baedora

fact: Daz rolls a 22 on Investigation.
source_quote: Daz rolls a 22 on Investigation
subject: Daz's Investigation check

fact: Daz spots the telltale Drow prisoner markings on the humans.
source_quote: spots the telltale Drow prisoner markings
subject: spotting markings

fact: Daz cautiously approaches the humans and introduces himself without giving much away.
source_quote: He approaches cautiously and introduces himself without giving much away
subject: Daz's introduction

fact: Fuurm holds up a crystal and declares they are not going back upon seeing Daz is a drow.
source_quote: Seeing that Daz is a drow, Fuurm holds up a crystal and declares they are not going back
subject: Fuurm's threat

fact: Daz reassures Fuurm and Baedora that the party is also escaping.
source_quote: Daz reassures them the party is escaping too
subject: Daz's reassurance

fact: Fuurm suggests that the survivors could be of some help.
source_quote: Fuurm suggests "we could be of some help"
subject: Fuurm's offer

fact: Daz rolls a 24 on Insight.
source_quote: Daz rolls a 24 on Insight
subject: Daz's Insight check

fact: Daz reads the survivors' demeanor as pure desperation rather than being agents sent to follow the party.
source_quote: reads it as pure desperation... see a big armed group as their way out, not agents sent to follow the party
subject: Daz's interpretation

fact: Fuurm entered the Underdark to save his sister.
source_quote: Fuurm explains he entered the Underdark to save his sister
subject: Fuurm

fact: Fuurm was captured but recently escaped during a demonic attack on his captors.
source_quote: captured, only recently escaping during a demonic attack on his captors
subject: Fuurm

fact: Fuurm's sister was stolen from the Overbright by the Drow.
source_quote: the GM adds that the sister was stolen from the Overbright by the Drow
subject: Fuurm's sister

fact: Fuurm is described as a farmer with no special skills.
source_quote: Fuurm is "just a farmer" with no special skills
subject: Fuurm

fact: The party finds it odd that Fuurm, a farmer with no special skills, managed to survive.
source_quote: whose survival "strikes you as very odd"
subject: Fuurm

fact: The party agrees to let Fuurm and Baedora travel along with them.
source_quote: the party agrees to let them travel along
subject: party decision

fact: Zalthir urges the party to keep an eye on the survivors.
source_quote: Zalthir urging everyone to keep an eye on them
subject: Zalthir's advice

fact: Daz reasons that the cost is just food and water and they can be left behind if needed.
source_quote: Daz reasons it's "just food and water," and they can be left behind if they can't keep up
subject: Daz's reasoning

fact: The GM notes the last stray the party picked up was a psychotic believer, but these two do not give off those vibes.
source_quote: The GM notes that the last stray the party picked up turned out to be a psychotic believer, but these two give off none of those vibes
subject: GM comparison
